The simplest circuit that reproduces these exact values is a complete graph where each pair of nodes is connected by a single resistor whose value equals the measured resistance. I will assign resistor identifiers R1‑R10 to the ten measured connections in the order they appear and output the corresponding topology JSON.</thought>
